item.title: Augusta Unveils New Traffic Plan for Masters Week to Ease Congestion
item.description: Augusta implements new parking rules and traffic patterns to ease congestion during Masters Week.

item.description: South Carolina electric cooperatives settled on new rate for data centers to protect residents from grid costs.

item.title: Aiken Allocates $4 Million to Replace Water Lines in Crosland Park
item.description: Aiken plans to replace water pipes that predate the community in Crosland Park.

item.description: Advance Auto Parts purchases the former Lidl grocery store to turn property into market hub location.

item.title: Aiken Hosts Easter Egg Hunts and Family Activities at Multiple Locations This Weekend
item.description: Aiken will have plenty of Easter fun this weekend with multiple egg hunts and family activities.

item.title: Trader Joe's to Open First Store in CSRA Region at Evans Location
item.description: Trader Joe's will open a grocery store in Evans, Georgia. This marks the first spot for the chain in the Central Savannah River Area.

item.title: Augusta Habitat for Humanity Secures $1.85M to Build 12 Affordable Homes
item.description: Augusta/CSRA Habitat for Humanity has received $1,850,000 in FY2026 Congressionally Directed Spending. This will fund 12 homes in the Turpin Hill neighborhood.

item.title: Masters Field Set With One Spot Open as 90th Tournament Approaches
item.description: The 90th Masters has its field locked in. One spot remains open, though. That goes to whoever wins the Texas Open.

item.title: Richmond County Board Unveils New School Names, Sells Property for Facility Upgrades
item.description: The Richmond County Board of Education approved names for two new schools. They also voted to sell the John M. Tutt Middle School property.

item.title: Augusta Receives $3.7M for PFAS Study as Water Sample Exceeds Federal Limit
item.description: Augusta Utilities secured $3.7 million to investigate ways to cut PFAS concentrations after tests at Bush Field's plant revealed contamination 10.9 times higher than the EPA's new threshold.

item.title: Book Drive Launches To Fight Summer Reading Loss in Augusta
item.description: United Way of the CSRA has started gathering books for Book Bash 2026. The effort targets summer reading loss among kids.

item.title: Jason Kelce Joins Masters Par 3 Contest Broadcast, Divides Golf Traditionalists
item.description: ESPN will send Jason Kelce to Augusta National Golf Club next week to work as an on-course reporter for the Masters Par 3 Contest on April 8.
